ideas.pitch: A telemetry-to-tuning companion app that analyzes blackbox logs from Betaflight after a test flight and automatically suggests PID tuning adjustments for tight obstacle courses.
ideas.title: AeroTune FPV
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages software optimization to improve drone agility and pilot handling for the timed obstacle course without risking hardware mid-event.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computing gate timer and fault-detection system using an ESP32 and camera module to automatically log lap times and penalize course deviations via computer vision.
ideas.title: GateWatch Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides reliable, automated judging infrastructure that helps race coordinators accurately track adjusted times during the high-speed event.

ideas.pitch: A low-latency wireless relay system placed across the obstacle course to stream live telemetry and emergency kill-signal overrides directly to the pilot station.
ideas.title: OmniGate Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on robust hardware communication and safety mechanisms, which aligns well with responsible flight control guidelines.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight secondary sensor module mounted on the drone chassis that tracks g-force limits, maximum tilt angles, and battery health to ensure compliance with weight and safety limits.
ideas.title: Inertial Flight Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the practical verification challenge of checking drone weight and flight safety parameters before race registration.

ideas.pitch: An optional FPV overlay simulator built for training pilots on dynamically generated obstacle courses before they take their physical run.
ideas.title: PathFinder HUD
ideas.why_it_could_win: Gives competitors a practical tool to adapt on the spot when the surprise course layout is revealed at the venue.
